record.question: What is the theme of International Literacy Day 2025?
options: Promoting literacy in the digital era
record.explanation: Answer D: Promoting literacy in the digital era. UNESCO announced the 2025 International Literacy Day theme as “Promoting literacy in the digital era.” Reference: https://www.unesco.org/en/days/literacy. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
